sentences.text:
Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd vs Deepak Mehra on 27
September, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:28731
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Alok Awasthi

On The 27th Of September, 2025
 Misc. Petition No. 5351 of 2025
 Icici Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd
 Versus
 Deepak Mehra And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Manoj Jain - Advocate for the petitioner.

Order 
This miscellaneous petition has been preferred by the petitioners under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, against the order dated 12.11.2024 passed in MACC No.3479/2022 by XVI Member, MACT, Indore whereby claim of the respondent/claimant has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. Facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed on 07.11.2022 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 30.06.021 along with an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication in SLP (C) No. 9152/2023.
Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order in MACC NO. 3479/2022.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:28731 2 MP-5351-2025 5.

In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
6. With the aforesaid observations, this petition is disposed of.
